name: kubernetes
description: Reads a Kubernetes cluster with kubectl: drafts nodes, apps and hostnames into the topology, refreshes pod counts and usage, and shows live CPU, memory and pods per node.

commands.import: Propose what the cluster has that the file doesn't: node usage and capacity, new nodes, pod counts per app, ingress hostnames, domains. Plugin args: --no-add only updates what is already there

live.description: CPU and memory (kubectl top), pods and readiness per node
